description: Track a 100-day challenge with a checkable 100-cell grid, streaks and stats.

faqs.a: Click any cell to toggle it checked (done) or unchecked. The grid fills in order but you can toggle any day.
faqs.q: How do I check off a day?

faqs.a: The longest streak is your longest run of consecutive checked days, in grid order.
faqs.q: What is the longest streak stat?

faqs.a: Yes — your checks are stored in localStorage in this browser.
Click Reset Challenge to clear all 100 cells and start over (with confirmation).

howto: Set your challenge name and start date (optional).
Click cells to check off completed days.
Watch your completion %, current streak and longest streak update.
Use Reset Challenge to start over.
title: 100-Day Challenge Tracker
